base_member_text: [L4-L12] (MED/working-directory/contract) The script assumes its current directory is the installation parent and does not check `chmod`, `cd`, or `scp`, so a missing install tree or transfer failure can be reported as success.
audit_member_text: [L6-L12] (MED/error-handling) A failed cd does not stop scp, allowing bin and lib from the previous working directory to be distributed.

adversarial.rationale: After a failed cd at trunk/config/teamcity-distribute.sh:8, the final scp still resolves relative bin and lib against the preceding working directory, with no repository-supplied caller or profile guaranteeing errexit. The primary claim holds when those entries exist and the transfer succeeds; the alternate wording overstates failure masking because scp is the last executable command and its own nonzero exit status is propagated.
